components.name: deep-diff
components.evidence: dist/redux-logger.js is a minified rollup UMD bundle (define.amd) whose first functions are deep-diff's Diff classes (kinds "E","N","D","A", observableDiff, DeepDiff noConflict). redux-logger 3.0.6 depends on deep-diff ^0.3.5 and its repo has no lockfile at tag 3.0.6; the version comes from the code. Of 0.3.5-0.3.8, only 0.3.7 and 0.3.8 have the stack logic ("stack.filter(...)", "stack.push({ lhs: lhs, rhs: rhs })", "...lhs.hasOwnProperty(key)"), and only 0.3.8 guards it as "stack[stack.length - 1].lhs && stack[stack.length - 1].lhs.hasOwnProperty(key)" (0.3.7 has no "lhs &&"); the bundle has the guard, minified as "p[p.length-1].lhs&&p[p.length-1].lhs.hasOwnProperty(d)". deep-diff 0.3.8 was the latest 0.3.x when redux-logger 3.0.6 was published (2017-05-03 vs 2017-05-17; the next release, 1.0.0, is from 2018). LICENSE is byte-identical across 0.3.5-0.3.8.
